_comment: Regression tripwires for the paraphrase pillar on PUBLIC datasets (ADR-0016 / ADR-0017 / ADR-0020).
They are evaluated at the CONFIDENT cutoff (what the product asserts as a confirmed match), and were set
from the 2026-08-30 measured baseline (bi-encoder paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2) with a small
margin: recall -0.04, FPR +0.02. They exist to stop a model/threshold change from silently regressing;
they are NOT quality targets and must never be quoted as accuracy. PAWS is reported but not gated: its
positive/negative score distributions coincide (gap 0.007), so no bi-encoder threshold separates it, and
it tests semantic equivalence rather than derivation. Tighten a gate only after a change beats it.
